assets.caption: EXHIBIT 10-53 — Overhead Arrangement. Plan view of pipe rack, overhead condenser, support, overhead line, tower, and horizontal leg for flexibility; with elevation/isometric view showing tower temperature zones (180°, 310°, 400°), elevations (120'/36.570, 20'/6.100), calculated growth (A), line growth (B), horizontal leg (C), guide, support, line temperature 180°, and air cooler. Note: subtract growth (B) from growth (A); difference is used to calculate horizontal leg (C).
